symptom: Runtime Decision Ledger schema accepted synthetic JSON exponent overflow for currentOdds, requiredOdds and expectedValue under both nullable and BUY-specific rules, while validateRuntimeDecisionLedgerRecord rejects non-finite numbers. Python jsonschema Draft 2020-12 admitted Infinity for unbounded positive odds and both infinities for expectedValue. No private odds, real decisions or production behavior were accessed.
lesson: JSON Schema type:number and exclusiveMinimum:0 do not guarantee finite JavaScript numeric values when JSON exponent overflow parses to Infinity. Conditional BUY branches must carry the same finite constraints as the nullable top-level rules.
guardrail: Bound currentOdds and requiredOdds by exclusiveMinimum:0 and maximum:Number.MAX_VALUE, and expectedValue by +/-Number.MAX_VALUE, in both nullable and BUY-specific schema rules. Keep runtime Number.isFinite authoritative and synthetic overflow/boundary tests. Never infer authentic odds, BUY readiness or production authority from schema-only validation.
